rules: The planner chooses semantic intent only; it never emits coordinates, colours, font sizes or keyframes.
Map scenes require a supplied built-in or project locationId, reviewed routeId, or dated historical context before compilation.
Built-in atmospheric map contexts compile pressure-driven-flow and shifting-zone into illustrative Map Editor layers without model-authored coordinates.
Historical context can request a year, region and named polities. Connected dated outlines remain review-required; the automatic fallback is a sourced locator map.
Missing resources become explicit resourceRequests with a safe fallback. They never remove a locked segment or stop unrelated scenes.
Unsupported or ungrounded selections compile to a visible review card without losing narration timing.
Every locked transcript segment produces exactly one scene.
